gloss: cooking rice by adding it to boiling water

definitions.gloss: cooking rice by adding it to boiling water
definitions.explanation: A way of cooking rice in which the rice is put into water that is already boiling, rather than starting it in cold water and heating it. The rice then absorbs the water as usual, with no draining.

examples.japanese: {湯炊|ゆだ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{炊|た}いた→炊く：02127_taku⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate rice that was cooked by adding it to boiling water.

examples.japanese: {湯炊|ゆだ}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{炊飯器|すいはんき}→炊飯器：04972_suihanki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}わ→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{炊|た}く→炊く：02127_taku⟧⟦{伝統的|でんとうてき}→伝統的：04802_dentouteki⟧な⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧だ。
examples.english: Adding rice to boiling water is a traditional way to cook rice without a rice cooker.

examples.japanese: {湯炊|ゆだ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧、お⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{沸騰|ふっとう}した→沸騰する：21985_futtousuru⟧⟦お{湯|ゆ}→お湯：02518_oyu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{炊|た}きます→炊く：02127_taku⟧。
examples.english: In the yudaki method, the rice is put into water that is already boiling and then cooked.

notes:
Combines ⟦{湯|ゆ}→湯：01740_yu⟧ (hot water) and {炊|だ}き (cooking, from ⟦{炊|た}く→炊く：02127_taku⟧). Contrasts with the usual method, in which rice is put into cold water and then heated. Boiling rice in a large amount of water and draining it is a different method, {湯取|ゆと}り⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {湯炊|ゆだ}き⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{炊|た}く→炊く：02127_taku⟧: to cook rice by starting it in boiling water
- {湯炊|ゆだ}き⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧: rice cooked in boiling water
